recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆分葉核中性球，核分成4至5葉、以細絲相連，染色質粗塊狀，細胞質淡粉紅含細小顆粒；單顆五葉不足以判定過度分葉，需計數群體比例，整體符合正常中性球。
features: Mature granulocyte about twice the size of a red cell
Nucleus with four to five lobes joined by thin chromatin strands
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine lilac granules, no toxic granulation or vacuoles
Background red cells with a small irregular fragment nearby and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with four to five nuclear lobes connected by thin filaments, coarse chromatin and pale cytoplasm with fine lilac granules. There is no toxic granulation, Döhle body or vacuolization. A single five-lobed neutrophil is within normal limits; hypersegmentation requires six or more lobes or more than 5% of neutrophils with five lobes. A small irregular fragment adjacent to the cell is of uncertain significance in isolation. Findings are consistent with a normal segmented neutrophil.

ddx.vs: True hypersegmentation shows one or more cells with six or more lobes or >5% five-lobed neutrophils, typically with macro-ovalocytes, which cannot be established from this single cell.
A band has a non-segmented U- or S-shaped nucleus of uniform width without thin filaments.
Macropolycytes are about twice the size of normal neutrophils and often tetraploid, whereas this cell is normal-sized.
